metaTitle: Custom Folding Face Masks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom folding face masks for your team or event. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Folding face masks collapse flat for pocket or purse storage, making them ideal for teams that need masks on the go. Unlike standard masks, these pop open when needed and stay compact between uses. Decorate with your logo using full-color imprinting for a professional look that travels well.
heroAltText: Custom folding face masks with logo, flat-fold design for easy storage and portability
